tools.name: get_plan_overview
tools.title: Get plan overview
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's current financial plan: mode (individual or couple), goal amount, timeframe, monthly contribution, and the active participants.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.title: List investments
tools.description: List the signed-in user's active investments (assets) with type, institution, invested amount, current amount, bucket, FGC coverage and liquidity, plus totals.

tools.name: list_monthly_tracking
tools.title: List monthly tracking
tools.description: Return the most recent months of the signed-in user's monthly deposit tracking: month, planned total, actual total, shortfall, and status.

limit.description: How many recent months to return. Defaults to 12.
